scenarios.title: Ore source to persistent miner
scenarios.steps: Start disposable world and run one ALIFE-07 original native asteroid cycle with one persistent ALIFE-08 miner
scenarios.expected: One original ore debit and one native miner cargoID; no virtual ore
requiredEvidence: original source and cargo SQL rows
same original cargoID and stable fleetID
SQLite haul receipt
native station physical arrival / itemStore credit
two-client logs when applicable
